inventory.title: Processes and persistence
inventory.subtitle: What was running and what is set to start on its own, according to the latest inspection.
inventory.inspectionRunning: A process inspection is in progress; this page updates when it finishes.
inventory.noSnapshotDescription: The inspection reads running processes, network connections and persistence points (cron, systemd, SSH keys, sudo, PAM…). Start one now or create a schedule for it.
inventory.noSnapshotAskOperator: Ask an operator or administrator to start the first inspection.
inventory.runNotFoundDescription: Run {{id}} has no process inventory: it may be of another kind or may have been removed.
inventory.loadErrorDescription: The panel could not fetch the inventory: {{cause}}. Try again in a moment.

processes.searchHint: Name, executable, user, systemd unit or PID.
processes.noMatch: No process matches the filters. Clear the search or uncheck the filters.
processes.caption: Snapshot processes, with user, executable, package, usage, connections and flags
processes.legend: Package "—": no system package owns the executable, which deserves attention. CPU in % of one core; resident memory.
processes.noCmdline: No command line (kernel thread or exited process).
processes.cmdlineMasked: Passwords and tokens in the command line are already masked.
processes.emptyDescription: The inspection finished without recording processes. Check the run for warnings and inspect again.

persistence.baseline: This is the initial baseline: there is no previous inspection to compare with yet. From the next one on, the panel points out what was added, changed or removed.
persistence.noChanges: Nothing changed since the previous inspection.
persistence.empty: The inspection found no persistence points.
persistence.removedTitle_one: {{count}} item removed since the previous inspection
persistence.removedTitle_other: {{count}} items removed since the previous inspection
persistence.removedHint: Removals deserve a look too: an intruder may delete a key or rule after using it.
persistence.removedTitle_zero: {{count}} items removed since the previous inspection
